scientific.integrity: The motivating open full text was inspected at the model equations, displayed reproduction number, equilibrium classification, global-attraction theorem, Lyapunov calculation, and numerical parameter table. Earlier convex/nonlinear-incidence backward-bifurcation literature was checked to delimit novelty. The bundled symbolic verifier checks the exact equilibria, saddle-node threshold, and local spectra. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result classifies positive endemic equilibria below the reconstructed invasion threshold and gives an exact locally bistable counterexample. It does not provide a complete global phase portrait or basin classification for all parameters.

title: Convex incidence creates bistability below the published SIR threshold
